faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Los Altos?
faq.answer: Los Altos homeowners typically invest $9,000 to $22,000 for a full window replacement project. This premium Silicon Valley community — with median home prices well above $3 million — features large ranch homes and custom estates where premium window specifications are the norm. Projects covering 15–25 windows with Andersen or Milgard Ultra are common. Single window installation starts at approximately $700.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Los Altos?
faq.answer: Yes. Los Altos requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team handles all permit applications with the City of Los Altos Community Development Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Los Altos?
faq.answer: Los Altos's premium Silicon Valley market drives demand for top-tier products. We most frequently install Andersen 400-Series wood-clad for the city's high-value ranches, Marvin Elevate for custom estate projects, and Milgard Ultra fiberglass for maximum energy performance in the valley's warm climate.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Los Altos neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve all Los Altos neighborhoods including North Los Altos, South Los Altos, Country Club, and Rancho Adobe. Zip codes: 94022, 94024.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Los Altos?
faq.answer: Most Los Altos projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
